calls.title: Jeff Everhart and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The company has experienced remarkable growth, doubling its revenue to over $8 million, primarily driven by one sales representative contributing to strong product-market fit. Aiming to double revenue again this year, the sales mix currently stands at 25% self-serve and 75% enterprise, with a sales team expanding from 1 to 5-6 representatives since September. To support this scale, the marketing and DevRel teams are growing, focusing on building a vibrant community through user-generated content. Engagement efforts will tap into external platforms like Reddit. Additionally, the launch of an Email API Benchmark Dashboard seeks to provide valuable data to users, showcasing the company’s innovative marketing approach. Jeff's candidate fit, with experience in developer advocacy and community building, aligns well with the company's needs.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Developer Relations, Community Building, Feature Flagging, AI Coding, Email API Benchmarks
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Schedule and coordinate a follow-up meeting between Jeff Everhart and Scott, GrowthBook’s technical product marketer, to discuss technical details and assess fit for the Developer Relations role (36:30)

**Jeff Everhart**
Prepare for the follow-up conversation with Scott by reviewing technical aspects of GrowthBook’s product and Developer Relations role requirements to evaluate fit (36:30)
